repairs.gloss: the act of moving hurriedly and in a careless manner
repairs.current_note: Formal and weighty, naming the hurry as a fault to be answered for where *hurry* merely reports it.
repairs.reader_said: The example 'make haste and tell us; make haste, my love' is the set phrase for simply hurrying up and carries none of the carelessness this gloss requires, so it belongs to a different sense of haste; the note itself is acceptable.
repairs.axis: haste as plain fast movement → haste that turns careless and costs the mover dignity
examples: in his haste to leave he forgot his book
Well, Jane, make haste and tell us; make haste, my love.
In his haste he knocked the cup off the table.

synset_siblings.tone: The plainest name for going fast and going badly at once, with the carelessness carried quietly rather than pressed.
Puts the weight on momentum - a harder-edged, more headlong version of *hurry*, where the speed is what overrides the care.
The participle keeps the careless speed running on as an activity rather than a single lapse, unlike the finished act *rush* names.

whole_family.gloss: the act of moving with great haste
whole_family.tone: Great speed as a sudden break away, all abruptness and no blame - the carelessness that shadows *hurry* is absent.

whole_family.gloss: the act of moving with great haste
whole_family.tone: Speed as a short spirited burst, brisk and deliberate beside the startled suddenness of *bolt*.

whole_family.gloss: rushing about hastily in an undignified way
whole_family.tone: Makes the hurry small and skittering, so the loss of dignity comes out as comic rather than damning.

whole_family.gloss: rushing about hastily in an undignified way
whole_family.tone: The undignified hurry as graceless floundering - effortful disorder where *scamper* is merely quick and silly.

repairs.gloss: (used of opinions and actions) far beyond the norm
repairs.current_note: A bare intensifier of position that shoves an opinion or action to the far edge and says nothing about it beyond how far out it sits.
repairs.reader_said: The note describes a bare positional intensifier that 'says nothing about it beyond how far out it sits' — the same verdict-free force as far, which is labelled neutral — yet the charge is negative; note and charge contradict each other and one must be repaired.
repairs.axis: registering a degree past the norm → denouncing it as past all reason

synset_siblings.tone: Marks opinions and actions as standing well past the norm by commitment rather than by accident of degree, and eyes that commitment with reserve.

whole_family.gloss: far more than usual or expected
whole_family.tone: The one member whose excess can flatter, registering a degree far past what was expected as remarkable rather than as a fault.

whole_family.gloss: far more than usual or expected
whole_family.tone: Sizes an excess by calling it a wrong, so the same far-more-than-expected that *extraordinary* admires becomes something to answer for.

whole_family.gloss: far beyond a norm in quantity or amount or degree; to an utmost degree
whole_family.tone: Names the utmost degree flatly, measuring how far a quantity, amount or degree sits from the norm without ruling on whether that is a fault.

whole_family.gloss: beyond a norm in opinion or actions
whole_family.tone: Purely positional: it sets an opinion or action out past the norm and leaves the verdict to whoever is looking, where *outrageous* is all verdict.

whole_family.gloss: complete or extreme
whole_family.tone: Absolute rather than excessive, saying a thing is complete or extreme with nothing softening it, so its force is bleakness rather than blame.

whole_family.gloss: beyond normal limits
whole_family.tone: Convicts the overstepping of having no argument for itself, a heavier charge than the plain over-the-limit of *excessive*.

whole_family.gloss: greatly exceeding bounds of reason or moderation
whole_family.tone: Informal and dry, registering a large overshoot as a grumble rather than the protest that *outrageous* makes of the same gloss.

whole_family.gloss: beyond normal limits
whole_family.tone: The flat statement of the case, that the limit has been passed, without the indignation *unreasonable* adds to it.

whole_family.gloss: beyond normal limits
whole_family.tone: Formal and cool, sizing the overshoot rather than complaining about it as *unreasonable* does.

whole_family.gloss: greatly exceeding bounds of reason or moderation
whole_family.tone: The hottest word here: the excess is treated as an affront, and the word demands that someone object.

whole_family.gloss: beyond normal limits
whole_family.tone: Faults the excess for not being warranted rather than for its bulk, the quietest complaint among the words sharing its gloss.

repairs.gloss: an elaborate and systematic plan of action
repairs.current_note: The elaborateness is the point and also the catch: a plan worked out in enough system and detail that the working-out itself draws notice, where *system* names only the method.
repairs.reader_said: The gloss is the neutral 'elaborate and systematic plan of action' and both examples use the word approvingly ('such a delicious scheme'), so a negative charge contradicts it; the note's 'also the catch' only gestures at a disparagement it never states.
repairs.axis: a bare procedure for reaching an end → a plan whose intricacy is itself conspicuous
examples: A scheme of which every part promises delight can never be successful
It would be such a delicious scheme, and I dare say would hardly cost anything at all.

whole_family.gloss: an elaborate and systematic plan of action
whole_family.tone: The elaborateness is the point and also the catch: a plan worked out in enough system and detail that the working-out itself draws notice, where *system* names only the method.

whole_family.gloss: a preset plan of action in team sports
whole_family.tone: Purely technical - a single move settled in advance and belonging to the team's game, passing no verdict on whether the plan is any good.

whole_family.gloss: a procedure or process for obtaining an objective
whole_family.tone: The flattest member, a procedure or process identified only by the objective it is meant to obtain, with none of *scheme*'s insistence on intricacy.

whole_family.gloss: a plan of action adopted by an individual or social group
whole_family.tone: Adoption is what it adds - the plan has been taken up and stands as the settled course of whoever holds it, one person as readily as a whole social group.

repairs.current_note: Blunt and breezy where the rest are courteous — it grants the refinement but withholds the deference.
repairs.reader_said: "Blunt and breezy" and withholding deference describes the slang sense (dame as an informal word for a woman), not the refined-woman sense glossed here, where the word is formal and courtly.

synset_siblings.tone: The plain word for it — the refinement is granted without ceremony, where *gentlewoman* makes an occasion of it.
Deferential — respect offered to her rather than refinement described about her, and warmer than the starched *madam*.
Formal and ceremonious, the courtesy held at a polite distance where *ma'am* closes it.
The stateliest of the set — it treats refinement as her whole standing rather than a courtesy paid in passing.
